title: Adaptive Capacity Panel: Operator Audit & Scaling Timeline
creator: Maya Li
description: Background: Customers running Redwood Dedicated need a single-pane operator view to set throughput guarantees, observe autoscale behavior, and audit who changed scaling rules. Goal: Deliver an 'Adaptive Capacity Panel' in Console combining (1) scaling controls with preset policies and safety fences, (2) a throughput dashboard showing fleet-level and per-pool SLOs with percentile latency and token/sec heatmaps, and (3) an immutable change timeline/audit log with rollback links. Acceptance criteria: 1) Operators can apply a policy preset or custom policy and save with a reason; 2) Dashboard surfaces 95/99 latency, realized throughput, queued requests, and autoscale decisions for last 90 days; 3) All policy changes are captured in change log with user, timestamp, delta, and link to rollout; 4) UI exposes a 'rollback' action that triggers a controlled revert via backend API; 5) Mobile-responsive and accessible per REDWOOD UX guidelines. Non-goals: Deep autoscaling algorithm changes (engineering); on-prem offline mode for initial launch.
comments: 2026-03-10: Initial PRD draft and wireframe attached. Noted dependency on runtime telemetry API (ENG-57401).
2026-03-11: Design review — prefer presets over freeform for first release; asked to include pace limiter to prevent large instant scale-ups (DES-201).
2026-03-12: Engineering feasibility sync — backend needs a new 'policy-version' field and audit endpoint (ENG-57401, ENG-57402). Estimated 3 sprints of eng work.
2026-03-13: Security reviewed — audit log must be tamper-evident and exportable to SIEM. Set security gating for release.
2026-03-14: PM acceptance criteria refined. Added rollback flow and acceptance test plan.
notes: Tradeoffs: Console should avoid exposing raw scaling knobs that increase risk; using presets simplifies support. UX must make cost impact explicit. Rollback will be soft by default with canary for 5% traffic then broaden.
test_plan: 1) Integration test: apply preset -> observe autoscale events for synthetic load; 2) Audit test: change policy -> verify entry in immutable log and SIEM export; 3) Rollback test: revert -> assert policy versioning and no orphaned deployments; 4) Performance: load dashboard with 90 days of telemetry within 2s for common queries.
acceptance_tests: Operator can create preset and bind to pool (manual run)
Throughput dashboard shows 95p latency within 10% of telemetry service
Change log entries include user, timestamp, and delta (manual inspection)
Rollback action reverts policy within SLA window (e2e)
